title: Levent Alpöge claims proof of Generalized Riemann Hypothesis
summary: Levent Alpöge, described in the supplied account as an Anthropic mathematician, has posted a personal PDF claiming a proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis and says the argument was encoded in Lean with help from Claude. The account describes a manuscript exceeding 250,000 pages; commenters report a roughly 1.3 GB Lean archive containing about 15 million lines. The claim has not been independently confirmed, and commenters link both a purported separate human proof and verification work that was still in progress.
